description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class `AbstractWithOrigin` implementing the `WithOrigin` interface. It manages an optional `ActorRef` representing the origin, providing a constructor and a getter method for it.

classes.name: AbstractWithOrigin
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for objects that have an origin represented by an ActorRef, encapsulated in an Optional.

methods.name: AbstractWithOrigin
methods.description: Constructor accepting an optional ActorRef representing the origin.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the origin ActorRef if present.
